name: ultra-realistic-fashion-portrait
image_vibe: Fresh confident modern fashion with real skin texture, bold solid color, and clean ad-campaign polish
image_purpose: Create an Instagram-ready fashion campaign portrait or commercial lookbook visual.

prompt.project_info: An ultra-realistic professional studio portrait of an original adult fashion model against a bold solid-color background.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with a unique face and identity, natural skin texture and visible pores, sharp expressive eyes, subtle trendy makeup, glossy natural lips, modern hairstyle, and a confident youthful-adult expression. Keep her styling contemporary and commercial without imitating a public figure.
prompt.composition_elements: Half-body studio portrait with the subject centered against a bold solid coral, teal, or cobalt background, clean composition, confident fashion pose, sharp face and eyes, and enough negative space for an ad-campaign feel.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Hard directional studio lighting with clean highlights and bold contrast, bright colorful high-contrast commercial atmosphere, controlled background saturation, and natural skin variation rather than plastic retouching.
prompt.technical_specs: DSLR camera look, 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, high-resolution 8K-style detail, realistic pores and hair, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, premium commercial fashion photography, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic professional half-body studio portrait of an original adult fashion model with a unique face and identity. Give her fresh natural skin with visible pores and real texture, sharp expressive eyes, subtle trendy makeup, glossy natural lips, a modern hairstyle, and a confident youthful-adult expression. Use a bold solid coral, teal, or cobalt background, a clean contemporary ad-campaign composition, hard directional studio lighting with clean highlights and bold contrast, natural skin variation without plastic retouching, a DSLR camera look with an 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, high-resolution 8K-style detail, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, public-figure likeness, aging artifacts, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, watermark, text

assets.name: source solid-color fashion portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for half-body framing, solid-color background, hard directional light, natural skin texture, and modern ad-campaign mood; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the adult fashion-model concept, half-body composition, bold solid color, real skin texture, confident pose, and commercial photography intent. Use an original face and vary non-essential styling details.

changes: Clarified repeated young/youthful wording as an original adult subject and prohibited public-figure imitation.
